attribution: Amt für Statistik Berlin-Brandenburg / Senatsverwaltung für Stadtentwicklung, Bauen und Wohnen Berlin; Adressen Berlin, WFS adressen_berlin, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0; transformed to EPSG:4326.

limitations: Official address points per the Vermessungsämter numbering plans (stand: metadata revision 2026-04-02; latest per-record adr_datum is reported separately). Points mark addresses, not buildings, entrances, units or premises.
An address never implies vacant premises, commercial availability, rental terms or permitted use.
The WFS serves the live layer without an edition pin; consecutive downloads can differ. Raw page hashes differ per download because of the response timeStamp.
typ 'Platz/Straße ohne HNR' rows (ids prefixed S) are street/square reference points without a house number; qualitaet 'RBS' rows have no hko_id.
plr_nr/plr_name are provider-supplied LOR 2021 Planungsraum links; they are checked against the pinned berlin_lor snapshot, never reassigned.
Straight-line distance from an address point is not walking time.
Source access, CRS, paging and field mapping checked 2026-10-18.
